_comment: Workflows tracked by metrics/scripts/kpi_*.sh. Each entry has: suite (key of 'suites'; one Slack table per suite, in map order; defaults to 'pay'), label (row name, unique within its suite, ≤16 chars), platform (groups bug-catches; keep it distinct across suites), repo (owner/name), workflow_path (.github/workflows/file.yml). Optional branch: only count runs on that branch (omit to count all branches). Optional job_pattern: Bash regex; the conclusion comes from the matching job instead of the whole run. Works for jobs nested in called reusable workflows (e.g. pay-core's CD job, visible in event_release.yml's jobs).

workflows.label: kotlin
